links.outcome: Self-reported significant errors in LLM outputs used by biostatisticians, including hallucinated functions
links.effect: 29 of 41 respondents (70.7%) reported significant errors, including incorrect code, statistical misinterpretations, and hallucinated functions; verification strategies included expertise, external validation, debugging, and manual inspection.
links.quote: however, 29 of 41 respondents (70.7%) reported significant errors, including incorrect code, statistical misinterpretations, and hallucinated functions.

unlisted_practices: Eight core principles for responsible LLM integration in biostatistical workflows (proposed, not tested)

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of biostatisticians at academic medical centers describing real-world usage patterns, errors encountered, and verification practices when using LLMs for clinical and translational research workflows.
